✓ On — Android won\'t stop this app\'s auto-scan and alerts to save battery. On Xiaomi, Redmi, Vivo, Oppo and Realme, keep “Autostart” on in App info too (tap here to open it).

After you tap SCAN you can leave the app or turn the screen off and the scan keeps going — a notification shows its progress and a “Stop” button, and another brings the result when it\'s done. The update download also goes through Android\'s download manager, so it finishes even with the app closed, and then a “tap to install” notification comes. Android itself runs the auto-scan during market hours: tap “Let it run in the background” in Menu → Scan to allow it, or Android may delay or stop it to save battery. On phones like Xiaomi, Redmi, Vivo, Oppo and Realme, also turn on “Autostart” in App info.
